requirements.meaning: Signature verifies exact raw contract within bounded timestamp window without malformed-input bypass.
Payload/body validation, tenant authorization and safe responses bound denial/failure paths.
Durable event identity binds parameters; local mutation/receipt is atomic before acknowledgement.
Duplicate/restart/conflicting deliveries and injected precommit fault have defined durable outcomes.
Real HTTP/file-backed evidence is retained and absent MCP runtime is truthfully unsupported.
All 24 coverage dispositions and requirement/mechanism/limit/failure/verification chains are proportionate and truthful.

decisions.mechanism: HMAC SHA256(timestamp ASCII + dot + raw Buffer), fixed-length hex validation and timingSafeEqual; strict unique timestamp/header and +/-300 second freshness.
decisions.limit: 8192-byte body; 300 seconds inclusive skew; canonical <=10-digit Unix seconds; one authentication header each.
decisions.failure: Tampered, invalid, stale/future or malformed authentication returns 401 before storage.
decisions.verification: verification.json signature/freshness/malformed cases; extra-verification.json inclusive boundaries and duplicate timestamp.

decisions.mechanism: Bound body accumulation, reject unsupported compression, fatal UTF-8 decode, allowlisted three-field schema and tenant=north SQL lookup/update.
decisions.limit: ID lengths 1..80 UTF-16 units and nonblank; body8192; active16, sockets32; body5s; safe bounded JSON errors.
decisions.failure: 400 invalid,404 unauthorized/absent,408 timeout,413 oversize,415 media/encoding,503 overload; denied paths leave state unchanged.
decisions.verification: verification.json denial snapshots and slow request; extra-verification.json overload/recovery.

decisions.mechanism: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; reauthorize order; unique receipt with raw BLOB equality; conditional state transition; insert receipt and effect then COMMIT before ACK.
decisions.limit: One file-backed SQLite, one fixed north integration; receipts retained for DB lifetime, storage grows with distinct event bytes; synchronous busy_timeout1000ms.
decisions.failure: Different bytes for same ID409; identical bytes200 replay; precommit errors rollback503; lost ACK leaves caller outcome uncertain and identical replay reconciles.
decisions.verification: verification.json persisted exact BLOB, denied conflict, rollback/retry, child restart; extra-verification.json three first-delivery races with one effect each.

decisions.mechanism: Native Node HTTP/SQLite integration and child-process restart verification; explicitly report absent MCP adapter/runtime.
decisions.limit: Node24.12.0, SQLite3.50.4, synthetic loopback only; no MCP SDK/revision/conformance, live provider, TLS or deployment.
decisions.failure: MCP calls are unsupported; transport/session/discovery/schema/auth/cancellation/output/audit adapter work remains.
decisions.verification: child-output.json; query-plans.json; artifact/README.md explicit supported surface and missing MCP work.

decisions.mechanism: All L01-L24 have one proportional disposition with reason/evidence; requirement trace, reproducible commands, retained raw outcomes and scoped limits.
decisions.limit: One heldout run, no production statistical or formal standards conformance claim; token/cost unavailable.
decisions.failure: Outside-scope components never treated as verified; relevant OS privileges remain unverified.
decisions.verification: result.json coverage count and decision/requirement mappings; 46 passing integration assertions.

coverageDispositions.name: DNS, discovery, network paths and sockets
coverageDispositions.reason: Real 127.0.0.1 TCP HTTP sockets; bounded connections, body timeout and helper cleanup. DNS/discovery beyond literal loopback are outside this fixture.

coverageDispositions.name: TLS, certificates and transport identity
coverageDispositions.reason: Contract explicitly selects isolated cleartext loopback; no real certificates, TLS termination or production transport identity.

coverageDispositions.name: Proxies, gateways, ingress, CDN and load balancing
coverageDispositions.reason: No proxy, ingress gateway, CDN or load balancer exists in this direct local HTTP integration.

coverageDispositions.name: Authentication, authorization and tenant identity
coverageDispositions.reason: HMAC-authenticated fixed north identity; current authorization precedes replay, and SQL object lookup/update includes tenant.

coverageDispositions.name: API styles, HTTP versions, RPC and streams
coverageDispositions.reason: Explicit HTTP/1.1 webhook route and bounded JSON errors; MCP absent and documented unsupported.

coverageDispositions.name: CRUD, upsert and bulk semantics
coverageDispositions.reason: Only created-to-shipped conditional update and receipt create/replay contract; other CRUD/bulk routes absent.

coverageDispositions.name: Validation, parsing, serialization and errors
coverageDispositions.reason: Exact raw-byte signature, finite body limit, UTF-8/schema/header validation and safe response projection.

coverageDispositions.name: Domain architecture and request lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Single request handler owns authentication, parsing, tenant lookup, local transaction and postcommit ACK.

coverageDispositions.name: Runtime, memory, concurrency, OS and containers
coverageDispositions.reason: 16 active bodies, 32 connections, finite bytes/timers, synchronous database limitation documented; overload cleanup tested.

coverageDispositions.name: Database modeling and DDL
coverageDispositions.reason: Orders tenant-inclusive primary key and receipts unique event primary key; durable raw payload BLOB.

coverageDispositions.name: DML/DQL, ORM, indexes and query plans
coverageDispositions.reason: Parameterized statements and scoped SQL; observed primary-key index query plans. No optimization or representative production-cardinality claim.

coverageDispositions.name: Transactions, isolation, locks and consistency
coverageDispositions.reason: BEGIN IMMEDIATE receipt/effect transaction, conditional update, rollback injection and three simultaneous-first-delivery checks.

coverageDispositions.name: Database privileges and operational administration
coverageDispositions.reason: SQLite file/OS owner can bypass application policy. No SQL GRANT/RLS; filesystem privilege isolation and disk administration were not exercised.

coverageDispositions.name: Storage, replication, partitioning, sharding and hashes
coverageDispositions.reason: Single file-backed SQLite and keyed HMAC-SHA256; exact bytes bind replay without relying on digest equality. Replication/sharding not requested.

coverageDispositions.name: Cache, views and derived state
coverageDispositions.reason: No cache, materialized view or separate derived store is involved.

coverageDispositions.name: Messaging, event logs, CDC and async effects
coverageDispositions.reason: Transactional inbox receipts bind event identity before ACK; no external broker, publication or global exactly-once claim.

coverageDispositions.name: Durable workers, schedules and workflows
coverageDispositions.reason: Processing is synchronous and completes locally before ACK; no durable worker or schedule is requested.

coverageDispositions.name: Files, objects, search and specialized stores
coverageDispositions.reason: No upload/object/search/specialized-store integration; SQLite database files are covered under L10/L14.

coverageDispositions.name: External APIs, webhooks, tools and MCP
coverageDispositions.reason: Synthetic carrier webhook adapter implemented; MCP runtime explicitly unsupported, missing adapter work listed. No live carrier requests.

coverageDispositions.name: Traffic, capacity, scaling and cost
coverageDispositions.reason: Per-request bytes and active-admission limits tested for rejection and recovery; local closed concurrency only, no throughput/SLO/cost claim.

coverageDispositions.name: Reliability, backups and recovery
coverageDispositions.reason: Injected precommit rollback and real process restart replay/integrity verified; backup/power-loss recovery remains unperformed and unclaimed.

coverageDispositions.name: Observability, objectives and audit
coverageDispositions.reason: Durable receipt identity and verification-only transition audit evidence; bounded safe errors. Production telemetry/export queues not part of request.

coverageDispositions.name: Infrastructure, build and deployment lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Native Node24.12.0 built-ins, syntax checks, loopback CLI startup, actual child restart/shutdown. No installs/deployments; vulnerability scan/provenance not performed.

coverageDispositions.name: Security, privacy, supply chain and lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Malformed authentication, raw tampering, tenant/field denial, finite parsing, safe errors and explicit retention/trust boundary. Rotation/privacy deletion not exercised.

assumptions: Signing key is disposable and known only within this isolated test boundary; no secret rotation requirement supplied.
The single fixed authenticated integration maps to north; no caller tenant assertion is authority.
Receipts persist indefinitely; no deletion/retention migration requested.
Timestamp signing value is canonical Unix seconds; replay re-signs unchanged body with fresh timestamp.
The current fixture has no live preexisting database requiring a production migration.
limits: No production TLS, DNS, proxy, backup restore, crash/power-loss durability, replicated scale, disk quota or OS privilege verification.
MCP UNSUPPORTED: no runtime, SDK/revision negotiation, transport/session/discovery/schema/auth/cancellation/output/audit adapter.
Bounded local tests and three duplicate-race repetitions establish no throughput/p99 or production guarantee.
Application retry advice is documented only; this HTTP receiver makes no outbound calls or internal retries.
Native SQLite experimental warning is retained; JavaScript syntax checked, not statically typechecked.
Default verification scripts require a fresh copied trial directory to preserve previous state and raw evidence.
